# Synthetic DICOM JPEG 2000 fixture

The `.pgm`, `.j2k`, `.jp2`, and `.dcm` files share a 4×4 grayscale image with
sample values `0, 32, 64, 96, ... 160, 255`. FFmpeg's JPEG 2000 encoder creates
the raw Part 1 reversible 5/3 codestream (`-pred dwt53 -format j2k`) and the
boxed JP2 container (`-pred dwt53 -format jp2`). The DICOM Part 10 variant wraps
the raw codestream as one encapsulated frame using transfer syntax UID
`1.2.840.10008.1.2.4.90` and Secondary Capture SOP Class UID.

The DICOM fixture contains no patient or study identifiers. The companion
`sample_jpeg2000_rgb.ppm`/`.jp2` files are a synthetic 4×4 primary-color RGB
image. `sample_jpeg2000_gray16.pgm`/`.jp2` are a synthetic 4×4 grayscale image
with 16-bit samples spanning 0–65535. `sample_jpeg2000_rgba.pam`/`.j2k`/`.jp2`
are a synthetic 4×4 RGB image with alpha values 255, 128, 0, and 64. These raw
and boxed encodings use FFmpeg's reversible 5/3 transform. The fixtures exercise JPEG
2000 decoding, raw/boxed stream support, RGB channel order, 16-bit
normalization, straight-alpha preservation, and bounded SIZ-header validation;
they do not test clinical interpretation or de-identification.

`sample_jpeg2000_rgba_preblended.jp2` is generated by `scripts/generate-jpx-preblended-fixture.py` with FFmpeg 8.0.1 from the RGBA PAM source. The RGB samples are preblended with blue matte `[0, 0, 1]` using `c' = m + alpha * (c - m)`; its SHA256 is `1a6970ecee77536181473ce6b5c343db9e9e0084a5ccbbd9948af7caea241a15`.

`sample_jpx_alpha.pdf` wraps the boxed RGBA JP2 with `/SMaskInData 1`; `sample_jpx_smask_in_data_2.pdf` wraps the preblended JP2 with `/SMaskInData 2` and the matching `/Matte`; `sample_jpx_soft_mask.pdf` wraps RGB JP2 plus an external 2x2 grayscale `/SMask`. These exercise intrinsic alpha modes and separate masks using self-authored synthetic images; no personal or clinical content is present. PDF wrapper hashes are recorded in `pdf_images.provenance.json`.
